instruction: Delete 'reddit.com' from Chrome's startup pages to prevent it from opening on launch.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://reddit.com/", "http://news.ycombinator.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: This task requires removing a specific URL ('http://reddit.com/') from Chrome's startup URLs list. The setup configures Chrome with two startup URLs: reddit.com and news.ycombinator.com. The custom getter checks if reddit.com has been removed from the startup URLs list and returns 'true' if successfully removed, 'false' if still present. The custom metric performs exact match comparison expecting 'true'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome preferences file and checks if the specified URL (http://reddit.com/) is absent from the startup_urls list
Metric correctly handles the 'type: rule' expected format by accessing expected.get('expected') to retrieve the rules dictionary value

Expected value semantically correct: check_url matches the exact URL format used in setup configuration
No UI state dependency - verification only requires reading the Chrome preferences file, which is always accessible
